NP Presspad 1.2.6 — Featured images from the media library

A fix for choosing a featured image. **No companion plugin update needed.**

## Featured images

- Choosing a featured image from the site's media library now shows it straight away. It previously looked as though the click had done nothing: the image was set correctly behind the scenes, but the preview couldn't display it until the post's image list happened to reload — up to 30 seconds later, and longer if you kept typing.
- Uploading a new featured image had the same delay, and is fixed too.
- Choosing from images already in the post was never affected.
- If an image can't be used for some reason, the picker now says why instead of appearing to ignore the click.
